digest.component_or_area: Config-ownership AST gate and approved-owner registry
propositions: An AST gate must flag prohibited ambient config/credential reads, load_config calls, and backend-registry accesses in modules outside approved composition-root and provider-credential boundary seams.

The gate must reuse gen_env_registry's env-read detection and KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS shim table as single source, and resolve receiver-object aliases (e.g., src=os.environ; src.get(...)) to detect evasions.

Owner sets must be derived at runtime from _child_env.owned_secret_names(), static @register decorator scans of adapters/, and gen_env_registry.scan() + _deprecations.REGISTRY, not hand-copied; newly declared env names lacking an owner must fail.

Synthetic fixtures must demonstrate each of the six detection categories (ambient env read, helper-shim read, load_config call, literal-getattr, credential read outside boundary, backend reload) in direct/import-aliased/local-aliased forms, all failing with path/symbol/access-kind/owning-seam diagnostics.

A legacy-exception registry with exact path+symbol+rationale entries must cover current below-seam reads to permit gate introduction without product-code changes; path-glob exceptions must be rejected structurally.
The gate must run offline without network/CI, expose check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int contracts, be unit-tested, and exit 0 on the current tree.
